title: volvulus pubescens
intro: Volvulus pubescens, commonly known as wild yam, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Dioscoreaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to alleviate menstrual cramps, menopausal symptoms, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Volvulus pubescens include diosgenin, a steroid saponin with therapeutic actions that include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to relax smooth muscles, reduce spasms, and modulate the immune system, making it a valuable resource in natural medicine.
